scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Those Exact Words
cards.instruction: Choose one phrase from the interaction and keep returning to what its wording must reveal about the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You wrote 'welcome for now.' Why for now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant you're welcome to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then now has brought an unnecessary suitcase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're reading too much into it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Too much is another interesting measurement of my welcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your note says I'm 'welcome for now.' Should I unpack?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I meant until your flat's repaired.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why 'for now' instead of 'until the repairs'? Is your welcome wearing out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cross it out. You're welcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: But 'for now' was there before I complained. What happens when I stop asking?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 selects 'for now', but A5 switches to 'too much' instead of returning to that chosen phrase.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 challenges B2's omission of 'now'; A5 uses B4's exact language, although that weakens card fidelity.

relationship.evidence: B2 clarifies hospitality and B4 resists interpretation, but neither adds a concrete hosting constraint.

heightening.evidence: A5 starts a new wording complaint rather than deepening the original phrase's implications.

specificity.evidence: A1 identifies a written welcome and B2 establishes permission to stay.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's suitcase metaphor is apt, but A5's 'measurement' adds another polished abstraction.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 selects 'for now'; A3 and A5 keep returning to what those same words reveal about the durability of welcome.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 contrasts B2's repair explanation with the original wording; A5 treats B4's deletion as a response to complaint rather than reassurance.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers accommodation until repairs and B4 offers to amend the note, giving A substantive attempts at reassurance to reinterpret.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes even removal of the phrase evidence that welcome may depend on continued questioning.

specificity.evidence: A1's note and unpacking question establish temporary lodging; B2 gives the concrete reason: repairs to A's flat.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Is your welcome wearing out?' and A5's complaint distinction arise directly from the disputed phrase.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 supplies the repairs explanation; A3 asks why that wording was not used instead of 'for now.'
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers to cross out the phrase; A5 distinguishes the original intention from an amendment made after objection.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: The same phrase remains the basis of A's relational interpretation in A1, A3 and A5.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 makes editing the note insufficient and extends the concern to future unspoken withdrawal.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A repeatedly examines one chosen phrase as involuntary evidence of how conditional B's welcome really is.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General semantic nitpicking would move among interesting words without holding one phrase to its relational implications.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A5 abandons 'for now'; revised A3 and A5 both return to it, even after B offers to erase it.

records.recommendedEdit: The original breaks the one-phrase requirement. Added temporary lodging during repairs. Internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5 (A1/A3/A5 retain 'for now'), logic 5 (A3 uses B2's repairs; A5 uses B4's erasure), relationship 4 (B clarifies and repairs), heightening 4 (A5 distrusts correction), specificity 5 (note and damaged flat), brevityWit 4 (A3 welcome wearing out). Total 92; applicable gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: A's anxious interpretation overlaps with S92, but the sustained exact wording clearly supplies this card's distinctive mechanism. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5 can sound knowingly prosecutorial; A must sincerely believe the original wording reveals more than the correction.
records.alternativeComparison: This interrogates a written offer and its amendment; the friends alternative interrogates a spoken qualifier and its claimed reassuring purpose.

cards.title: Those Exact Words
cards.instruction: Choose one phrase from the interaction and keep returning to what its wording must reveal about the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said we're still friends. Still?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Friends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't quietly remove the word after I've heard it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a reassuring word.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reassuring against what, exactly?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said we're 'still friends' while taking me off the pub quiz team.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Friends. We just need someone who knows sport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You dropped 'still.' Does that mean friendship's the consolation prize for losing my chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come Thursday anyway. I'll save you a chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell the team we're 'still friends.' I want to hear which word you stress in public.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 selects 'still friends'; A3 resists removing 'still'; A5 questions why that same word is reassuring.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 notices B2's shortened 'Friends'; A5 directly interrogates B4's explanation of reassurance.

relationship.evidence: B2 affirms friendship and B4 explains benign intent, providing two different forms of reassurance.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's reassuring intention into evidence that the friendship faces a threat.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a friendship-status conversation through the precise disputed wording.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's short 'Reassuring against what' extracts the threatening implication directly from B4.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 selects 'still friends'; A3 scrutinizes B2's omission of 'still', and A5 requests the original phrase with public stress.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's 'Friends' prompts A3's omission analysis; B4's saved chair prompts A5 to test the phrase in front of the team.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants sporting knowledge on the team while preserving friendship; B4 offers inclusion, which A5 converts into a public reassurance test.

heightening.evidence: A5 escalates A3's private wording inquiry into scrutiny of how B will stress the same words publicly.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes removal from a pub quiz team; B2's sport gap and B4's Thursday chair provide concrete social stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'consolation prize' links friendship to losing a team place; A5's stress test earns its humor through continued verbal suspicion.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 repeats 'Friends' without 'still'; A3 names and interprets that exact omission.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers attendance and a chair, creating the public setting in which A5 now wants the phrase tested.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A returns to one phrase and treats its omission and prospective emphasis as evidence of friendship's status.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 expands the same wording investigation to an audience without dictating B's answer or the scene's outcome.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A holds onto 'still friends' and repeatedly treats its wording as evidence about whether friendship has become a consolation for exclusion.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Resenting exclusion alone would demand reinstatement; A instead keeps examining what the same phrase says about the friendship.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 notices B2 dropping 'still' and interprets the replacement as a consolation; A5 uses B4's invitation to request a public repetition of 'still friends' with audible emphasis.

records.recommendedEdit: The supplied candidate review found no concrete occasion or consequence. Added removal from a pub quiz team and an invitation to attend anyway. Preserved firstPass exactly. Separate internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5 (A1, A3 and A5 examine 'still friends'), logic 5 (A3 catches B2's omission; B4's invitation makes A5's public test possible), relationship 4 (B2 wants sports knowledge and B4 offers continued company), heightening 4 (A5 moves scrutiny from private wording to public emphasis), specificity 5 (A1 quiz exclusion and B4 Thursday seating), brevityWit 4 (A3's consolation prize links friendship to the quiz loss). Total 92; five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words, and all dialogue gates pass. This is internal model review only.
records.remainingConcern: A3's inference from dropping 'still' is deliberately strained, but recognizable as A's sincere insecurity. No rewrite is needed.
records.writerReservation: B4 does not establish whether the saved chair is at the team table or nearby. A5's proposed public repetition must remain sincere scrutiny rather than a calculated humiliation.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved housing alternative interrogates a written qualification and its deletion. This alternative interrogates a spoken omission and then seeks public emphasis after social exclusion.
